key_insight: MDM-VGB adds reward-guided remasking to masked diffusion, letting the sampler both unmask and revise tokens to better satisfy constraints and downstream rewards.
engineering_relevance: This gives inference-time control for discrete generative models, enabling efficient sample repair and higher-quality constrained generation without retraining the model.
method: Extends Jerrum-Sinclair backtracking from a fixed prefix tree to a masked-state graph.
Uses reward-guided unmasking/remasking moves to favor higher-value partial configurations.
Provides theory for robustness to verifier noise and quadratic-time sampling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong empirical results on constraint-satisfaction and scientific benchmarks, including Sudoku and QM9.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the process-verifier signal, so noisy or misaligned rewards can still affect search behavior.
paper_title: VGB for Masked Diffusion Model: Efficient Test-time Scaling for Reward Satisfaction and Sample Editing
